notes: Since πέραν is rendered by a single word, rule 71's frame question does not arise and the following article takes a bare *the* (rule 42).
ὁδὸν θαλάσσης is spread over separate English words, so no compound unit is built (rule 94); the ASV's gloss note records the literal *the way of the sea*.
The three supplied determiners on Γῆ, γῆ and θαλάσσης are anarthrous helpers on their nouns (rule 51).
